INSERT INTO feed_exports (tenant_id, market_id, channel, object_key, items, bytes,
                                           generated_at)
                 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, now())
                 ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, market_id, channel) DO UPDATE
                 SET object_key = $4, items = $5, bytes = $6, generated_at = now()
